home.hero_title: We design more than just a waterpark
home.hero_desc: We design innovative water entertainment systems that inspire, excite and create unforgettable experiences.
home.why_subtitle: Creating iconic waterpark experiences with 20+ years of expertise
home.why_desc: Polgün is a strong solution partner managing design, engineering, production, and implementation processes of waterpark projects under a single roof. With more than twenty years of industry experience, high production capacity, and international project experience, we offer reliable, innovative, and sustainable solutions for projects of all sizes. Combining aesthetics, safety, quality, and operational efficiency, we design and build unique waterpark experiences that deliver long-term value for brands and investors.
home.cta_title: We bring your dream waterpark to life
home.cta_desc: We bring color to life in waterparks all around the world. Contact us for your next project.

about.desc: Polgün is a strong solution partner that manages the design, engineering, production, and implementation processes of waterpark projects under one roof. With more than twenty years of industry experience, high production capacity, and international project experience, we offer reliable, innovative, and sustainable solutions for projects of every scale.
about.power_title: A Growing Power on the International Stage
about.power_desc1: Polgün started operating in Muğla-Menteşe in 2002. Today it continues its operations with 4 main production centers in Muğla, together with its offices in Istanbul and Spain, the Antalya office opened in 2022, and the new Bursa investment.
about.power_desc2: With its 120,000 m² integrated production infrastructure, fully automated machine park, and expert staff, it is one of the leading companies in the sector able to carry out steel construction and polyester manufacturing under the same roof.
about.power_desc3: With 425 employees and a 30-person R&D team, Polgün manages all processes from design to production and realizes turnkey projects.
about.arge_title: Muğla's First and Only R&D Center
about.arge_desc1: As Polgün Waterparks, the foundation of our R&D approach is to develop safe, innovative, sustainable, and high-value-added water entertainment technologies. Awarded the R&D Center status by Ministry approval in 2021, our center is the first and only R&D Center in Muğla, leading the way in original product development, localization, and technology production in our industry.
about.arge_desc2: In our R&D Center, with our 30 full-time equivalent qualified R&D personnel serving as researchers, technicians, and support staff, we carry out new product design, engineering analysis, prototyping, testing, validation, production method development, and intellectual property processes with a holistic approach.
about.arge_desc3: Our innovative product projects such as Navatu, Savana, Monarch Butterfly, and Eclipse are among the important R&D outputs representing Polgün's design, engineering, and manufacturing power in the international market.
about.misyon_desc: To bring unique solutions to the water entertainment industry by developing high-quality, safe, cost-effective, and innovative R&D projects.
about.vizyon_desc: To be a leading and pioneering R&D center shaping water entertainment technologies; to be a brand that produces technology, inspires the industry, and creates value for a sustainable future.

stats.staff_desc: Qualified expert team in full-time equivalent

about.production_subtitle: We manage all processes from design to production under one roof
about.production_desc: Polgün realizes the solutions developed for waterparks and entertainment systems with an integrated production infrastructure combining steel construction, mechanical processing, composite production, surface applications, and digital production technologies.
about.production_power: We Reflect Our Production Power in Our Projects
about.production_power_desc: By managing engineering, production, and quality control processes under the same roof, we develop reliable, high-quality solutions specific to each project.

entegre_depo.title: Integrated Raw Material & Logistics Warehouse
entegre_depo.desc: Polgün manages the supply, storage, and transfer to production of the raw materials, auxiliary materials, and technical equipment used in production within its own operational structure. Systematic stock and material management allows the different production units to access the inputs they need quickly and in a controlled way. Coordinating production, warehouse, and supply processes supports production continuity while strengthening material tracking and operational control.

model_kalıp.title: CNC Machining
model_kalıp.desc: With its 5-axis CNC model and mold production infrastructure supporting product development and production processes, Polgün transfers original and complex geometries to production with high precision. Managing all processes in-house, from digital design to model and mold production, ensures high surface quality, dimensional accuracy, and repeatability in production. Thanks to our CNC technology, project-specific designs and new-generation slide geometries, as well as standard products, are prepared for production quickly and in a controlled manner.

elyaf.title: Fiberglass & Reinforcement Preparation
elyaf.desc: Polgün prepares the glass fiber and reinforcement materials used in composite production to precise dimensions with CNC-controlled automatic cutting systems. Working from digital cutting data, the system cuts parts suited to different product geometries quickly, repeatably, and in a controlled manner. This technology helps reduce material waste, increase cutting precision, and shorten production preparation times. Carrying out fiber cutting and preparation in-house at Polgün supports continuous quality and process control in composite production.

kompozit.title: RTM Preparation
kompozit.desc: Polgün produces the composite parts used in water slides and waterpark products in-house with different production methods such as RTM, L-RTM, hand lay-up, and spray-up. Durable and repeatable production is achieved by using resin, reinforcement materials, and layer structures suited to the product geometry and performance requirements. In the following stage, gelcoat, surface finishing, coloring, polishing, and top coat applications complete the surface quality and visual integrity of the products. Carrying out all stages from composite production to surface applications in-house at Polgün ensures that product quality and process control are maintained at every stage.

çelik_işleme.title: Steel Processing & Cutting Technologies
çelik_işleme.desc: Polgün transfers designs to production accurately and in a controlled manner by using high-precision cutting and machining technologies in steel construction production. Thanks to CNC pipe and profile cutting systems, parts with different diameters, cross-sections, and geometries are prepared with high dimensional accuracy. Transferring digital design data directly to production allows support systems compatible with complex slide geometries to be prepared faster, more repeatably, and in a more producible way. Carrying out steel fabrication processes in-house, from cutting to welding and assembly preparation, strengthens quality and production control across the project.

çelik_konstrüksiyon.title: Steel Construction & Welded Fabrication
çelik_konstrüksiyon.desc: Polgün carries out the production of the steel structures used in water slides and waterpark systems in-house. Pipes, profiles, and steel parts prepared with CNC technologies are brought together through precise welding and assembly processes in line with project-specific geometries. Carrying out all stages from cutting to welded fabrication in an integrated way provides dimensional accuracy, production control, and project-specific flexibility in support systems. In this way, durable and controlled steel construction solutions compatible with different slide geometries are produced.

mekanik.title: Mechanical Machining & Parts Fabrication
mekanik.desc: Polgün produces in-house the special fasteners, flanges, and project-specific mechanical parts used in water slide systems and steel structures. The parts are prepared to precise dimensions in line with engineering data and made fully compatible with the assembly processes. Our mechanical machining capability provides dimensional accuracy, production repeatability, and fast project adaptation, while offering flexible solutions for non-standard geometries and project-specific technical needs. Managing the process in-house at Polgün, from design to manufacturing, ensures that part quality and production control are maintained at every stage.

boya.title: Painting & Protective Coating Applications
boya.desc: Polgün carries out surface preparation, painting, and protective coating of steel structures and metal parts in-house, in line with their conditions of use. The applied systems help protect metal surfaces against corrosion and environmental effects while completing the aesthetic integrity of the products. Thanks to controlled surface preparation and coating processes, durable, long-lasting solutions with high surface quality are achieved for different climates and project conditions.

kalite.title: Final Inspection & Product Protection
kalite.desc: At Polgün, composite parts that have completed production are inspected for surface quality and product integrity and prepared for the next stage. Measures to protect product surfaces during production, transport, and installation are carried out in a controlled manner. Carrying out surface inspection, protective applications, and shipping preparation in-house helps preserve product quality from the production facility to the project site.

paketleme.title: Packaging & Shipping
paketleme.desc: To deliver products whose production and quality checks have been completed safely to the project site, Polgün applies packaging and loading processes suited to the product type and shipping conditions. Composite parts, steel structures, and project equipment are prepared so that they are protected during transport and then shipped. Thanks to planned packaging, loading, and logistics coordination, products are transported from the production facility to the project site in a controlled and safe manner.

mugla.label: Headquarters Production Facility
mugla.desc: Main production and R&D center. The central facility housing the steel construction, composite production, and digital manufacturing infrastructure.

bursa.label: Bursa Production Facility
bursa.desc: Polgün's northern production center. The facility handles steel parts fabrication and semi-finished product manufacturing.

istanbul.label: Marmara Technopark
istanbul.desc: Marmara Technopark office where R&D and innovation studies are conducted. New product development and technical analysis center.

services.subtitle: Holistic Project Management
services.desc: Polgün provides high-standard, professional services at every stage of waterpark projects. Carrying out all processes from planning to design and from engineering to installation with its own expert team, it realizes turnkey projects.
services.process_title: We are with you every step of the way, from start to finish
services.cta_desc: Whatever the size of the project, we are with you from the first day to the last.

service.title: Full Service
service.desc: At every step, from design to production and from installation to maintenance.

countries.title: 70+ Countries
countries.desc: Global project experience and local expertise.

lifetime.title: Long-Term Support
lifetime.desc: After-sales technical support and spare parts supply.

step1.title: Product Design & Theming
step1.desc: Water slides, children's play groups, and waterpark attractions are custom designed according to the project concept and customer expectations. Color, pattern, theme, and visual details are developed in harmony with product geometry to create unique designs that enhance the visitor experience.

step2.title: Engineering & Project Design
step2.desc: Slide systems, steel support structures, and mechanical and hydraulic infrastructures are designed in detail by engineering teams. Structural calculations, technical analyses, production drawings, and assembly documents are prepared in line with project conditions.

step3.title: Production
step3.desc: Fiberglass slide parts, steel structures, models, molds, and project-specific components are prepared in Polgün’s production facilities. Production processes are carried out on the basis of dimensional accuracy, surface quality, durability, and traceability.

step4.title: Project Management & Shipping
step4.desc: Design, production, packaging, logistics, and site processes are coordinated in line with the project schedule. Products are prepared with an accurate coding and labeling system, packed securely, and delivered to the project site complete.

step5.title: Installation & Commissioning
step5.desc: Slides, steel structures, and related equipment are installed by experienced site teams or under Polgün technical supervision. After installation, connections, sliding surfaces, water flow, and system functions are checked in detail.

products.title: Our Products
products.desc: Discover our product range combining aesthetics, excitement, and the highest safety standards.

pirate_theme.desc: Polgün's signature theme, the Pirate Theme, is designed for children to sail in open seas full of pirates and have fun in this imaginary world.

underwater_theme.desc: An interactive play area that sparks children's curiosity about the underwater world, designed based on the different species waiting to be discovered and colorful corals.

navatu.sub: IAAPA Brass Ring Award-Winning Wave System
navatu.desc: Navatu is an innovative waterpark system developed at Polgün's R&D Center and awarded the Brass Ring award at IAAPA Expo Orlando. It takes the natural wave experience to a new dimension.

savana.sub: Themed Water Slide with Multiple Slide Paths
savana.desc: Savana is an innovative R&D project that combines four different slide paths in a single body, allowing eight users to experience different sliding styles at the same time. Its design was registered in 2024.

big_hole.desc: Big Hole is a large-scale enclosed water slide designed to offer a shared family rafting experience. Its wide-section tube structure delivers an impressive sense of speed and movement, turning the classic enclosed slide concept into a fun, social, and unforgettable family adventure.

big_raft.desc: Big Raft is a wide and comfortable family slide designed for shared use. Thanks to its wide sliding surface, families and groups of friends can experience speed and excitement together, combining social interaction with a delightful waterpark experience.

family_slide.desc: Family Slide is a multi-person raft water slide designed for families and groups to enjoy together. With its wide turns, smooth transitions, and rafts for up to four people, it offers interactive fun, a dynamic sliding experience, and a high-capacity waterpark experience.

family_tornado.desc: Family Tornado delivers the iconic funnel experience on a larger scale, allowing bigger groups to share the thrill together. Its wide funnel structure and strong oscillating motion provide high acceleration, a moment of weightlessness, and dynamic transitions. With its high capacity, impressive look, and a ride that makes guests want to go again, it is one of the standout family slides in waterparks.

mid_hole.desc: Mid Hole is an enclosed family water slide offering a wide and impressive ride. Its enclosed tube design builds curiosity and excitement throughout the journey, while providing a fun, comfortable sliding experience that families and groups can share.

ufo_slide.desc: UFO Slide is a family-friendly raft water slide inspired by the elliptical form of flying saucers. Its enclosed tube structure offers a smooth and comfortable ride for up to four users, and by combining shared fun with high play value, it adds an eye-catching family attraction to waterparks.

freefall.desc: Freefall is a high-adrenaline water slide designed to deliver the feeling of free fall at its most intense. With its almost vertical drop angle and uninterrupted high-speed track, it offers a short but extremely impressive sliding experience. It is a must-have waterpark attraction for thrill seekers.

hydro_river.desc: Hydro River is a new-generation raft water slide powered by advanced water jet technology. By maintaining continuous motion with water jets, it offers a smooth, dynamic, and uninterrupted sliding experience. Combining innovative technology, comfort, and fun, it creates a unique attraction for waterparks.

rocket_slide.desc: Rocket Slide is a high-adrenaline water slide whose trapdoor launch system suddenly releases the rider into a high-speed, gravity-driven descent. After the countdown, the unexpectedly opening floor, the feeling of free fall, and optional loop configurations combine to deliver one of the most thrilling experiences in the high-speed slide category.

uphill_slide.desc: Uphill Slide offers a dynamic sliding experience with successive drops and climbs along its undulating track. The changing acceleration and deceleration create a smooth, rhythmic sense of motion, giving riders long-lasting excitement and high entertainment value.

kamikaze.desc: Kamikaze is a classic water slide that offers high speed and intense adrenaline thanks to its stepped sliding surface. Sudden acceleration and deceleration effects further heighten the sense of speed; with its smooth ride, Kamikaze is one of the most popular waterpark attractions for thrill seekers.

slip_fly.desc: Slip & Fly is an original water slide developed by Polgün, designed to make riders feel as if they are skipping and flying over the water surface. Bringing together high speed, a striking visual experience, and intense adrenaline, it takes excitement to the next level and is one of the standout attractions of waterparks.

babochka.desc: Babochka combines its original butterfly-inspired geometry with a family raft slide experience. Its wide inclined transitions and controlled acceleration provide a smooth and dynamic ride, while its symmetrical, eye-catching design gives waterparks a strong visual impact and can be customized for different theme concepts.

boomerango.desc: Boomerango is a high-adrenaline raft water slide inspired by the returning motion of a boomerang. After a high-speed descent, riders climb an almost vertical wall, experience a moment of weightlessness, and then return to the slide track to continue their ride. With its dynamic motion and iconic design, it is one of the most eye-catching attractions of thrill-focused waterparks.

canyon_slide.desc: Canyon offers an exciting raft water slide experience with its compact, space-saving design. Along its dynamic track, riders feel rising, swinging, and returning all in one ride, creating an impressive attraction that delivers an unforgettable experience even where installation space is limited.

crazy_cone.desc: Crazy Cone offers a fun and energetic sliding experience with its distinctive conical design and smooth oscillating motion. After entering the wide cone section, riders enjoy an exciting journey full of surprises thanks to the changing directions of movement. With its striking look and a structure that adapts to different layout options, it is a standout attraction for waterpark projects aimed at families and young people.

drone.desc: Drone is a visually striking slide module that enriches the sliding experience with a sudden widening effect and a strong sense of space. The wide dome-shaped section gives riders an airy, spacious feeling before the track continues. Thanks to its visual impact, suitability for lighting applications, and easy integration into different slide systems, it is an innovative solution that adds excitement and aesthetic value to waterparks.

hill_slide.desc: Hill Slide is a raft water slide that delivers high speed and adrenaline with a steep drop followed by an impressive uphill climb. With its dynamic track, a ride that makes guests want to go again, and a design customizable in different colors and patterns, it adds an eye-catching, original attraction to any waterpark.

hydra_slide.desc: Hydra is a multi-lane racing slide that combines high capacity with a bold, iconic architectural design. Its original multi-headed structure offers simultaneous high-speed descents, enhancing the sense of competition and user interaction. It turns the classic mat racer concept into an impressive experience that becomes one of the landmark attractions of a waterpark.

magic_tray.desc: Magic Tray offers a dynamic raft slide experience through smooth banked turns, continuous changes of direction, and controlled acceleration. Its original design inspired by the saucer form creates an uninterrupted, rhythmic sliding feel, and with its family-friendly thrill, comfort, and strong visual impact it adds an eye-catching attraction to waterparks.

mini_boomerango.desc: Mini Boomerango offers the characteristic back-and-forth motion and thrill of the boomerang slide in a compact design. Thanks to its lower height and smaller footprint, it is an ideal solution for projects with limited space, Splash Tower systems, and compact waterparks. Despite its small size, it delivers a big sliding experience, making it a flexible and efficient attraction option.

space_rocket.desc: Space Rocket combines a futuristic design with a high-speed sliding experience to offer an exciting themed adventure. Along its original rocket-inspired structure, riders enjoy fast and smooth transitions; with its strong visual impact, Space Rocket delivers an unforgettable sliding experience.

super_bowl.desc: Super Bowl reinterprets the classic bowl slide experience with a longer spinning motion and dynamic acceleration. After circling several times inside the wide bowl section, riders move on to the exit track for a high-adrenaline and visually impressive sliding experience. Thanks to its flexible design options and high operational efficiency, it is a standout, eye-catching attraction for waterparks.

space_bowl.desc: Space Bowl is a compact yet impressive water slide that brings together speed, spinning motion, and visual excitement. Riders enter the bowl section from a high-speed enclosed tube, circle several times, and complete the ride with a thrilling final drop. With its iconic design, strong visual impact on spectators, and compact footprint, it is an eye-catching attraction that adds value to any waterpark.

tornado_slide.desc: Tornado offers a high-adrenaline raft water slide experience with its wide funnel structure and strong oscillating motion. Riders climb high up the funnel walls and then continue along the track through dynamic transitions, feeling as if they are moving inside a natural whirlpool. With its impressive design and intensely thrilling ride, it stands out as one of the landmark attractions of waterparks.

planeta.desc: Planeta is an iconic water slide that brings family-friendly thrill together with dynamic movement through its planet-like round form and impressive sliding profile. Along smooth transitions, wide turns, and accelerating spiral movements, riders feel as if they are travelling in orbit through space. Its sculptural design strengthens the visual identity of the waterpark while offering a balanced, unforgettable attraction that combines fun, movement, and the desire to ride again for visitors of all ages.

body_racer.desc: Body Racer is a competition-focused, multi-lane body slide where users can race side by side. Its design, which can be produced with open or enclosed tube options, lets riders see each other during the race and heightens the competitive thrill. Bringing together high speed, fun, and interaction, it is one of the essential racing slides of modern waterparks.

multi_slide.desc: Multi Slide is a multi-lane water slide that offers the joy of racing side by side with multiple lane options and an exciting free-fall start. Combining high speed, competitive fun, and high user capacity, it creates a dynamic, social, and eye-catching attraction for waterparks.

twister_slide.desc: Twister Slide is a competition-focused, multi-lane water slide consisting of 2 or 3 spiral tubes. As riders race side by side along enclosed spiral tracks, winding transitions and constant changes of direction heighten the excitement. Since the winner is not known until the finish line, it combines surprise, competition, and high entertainment value for an unforgettable experience.

racer_slide.desc: Racer Slide is a two-lane racing slide that brings together speed, competition, and social interaction. Riders race side by side on parallel tracks for a fun experience that makes them want to ride again. Its design, customizable in different colors and patterns, gives every waterpark a dynamic and eye-catching look.

spider_slide.desc: Spider Slide is a multi-lane water slide that offers a dynamic and competitive sliding experience with its tight turns and sharp curves. Thanks to its intertwined tunnel structure, up to four users can race side by side at the same time, increasing excitement and interaction. With its impressive architectural design and strong visual presence, it is one of the eye-catching racing attractions of waterparks.

aquatube.desc: Aquatube is a classic body slide that combines high speed with an impressive enclosed tube experience. Its design, which can be enriched with lighting effects and transparent or semi-transparent sections, offers riders a visually striking sliding experience. With its timeless design and broad appeal, it remains one of the most popular and essential waterpark attractions.

black_hole.desc: Black Hole is a classic raft water slide enriched with impressive light effects. The visual effects along its enclosed tube turn the ride into an immersive adventure. Bringing together speed, atmosphere, and fun, it remains one of the most popular and timeless waterpark attractions.

compact_slide.desc: Compact Slide is a practical water slide solution developed for limited spaces, offering easy installation and maintenance. Usable in Splash Tower systems, waterparks, or stand-alone applications, this model can be customized with different sizes, colors, and design options. Thanks to its flexible structure and efficient use of space, it offers a functional and economical attraction suitable for projects of every scale.

rafting_slide.desc: Rafting Slide is a high-capacity group slide inspired by the world's most successful family raft slides. With a track built on speed, wide wall transitions, and continuous changes of direction, it offers riders a dynamic sliding experience. Impressive drops, wide-radius curves, and smooth track transitions bring comfort and adrenaline together in balance for families and thrill seekers, creating an unforgettable waterpark experience.

wide_slide.desc: Wide Slide is a fun and social water slide that lets up to three users slide together at the same time. Its wide sliding surface allows families and groups of friends to enjoy the experience together. Its structure, customizable in different colors, patterns, and sizes, offers a flexible and visually eye-catching attraction that fits any waterpark.

body_slide.desc: Body Slide is one of the classic water slide models, offering users a smooth, comfortable, and enjoyable ride with its vivid colors and RTM technology. Thanks to its flexible and adaptable structure, it can easily be integrated into any waterpark, either as a stand-alone attraction or as part of different slide combinations. With its timeless design and wide range of uses, Body Slide is one of the essential slide solutions for waterparks.

arge.hero_desc: At Polgün Waterparks, the foundation of our R&D approach is to develop safe, innovative, sustainable, and high-value-added water entertainment technologies.
arge.p1: Our center, which gained R&D Center status with Ministry approval in 2021, leads original product development, localization, and technology production efforts in our sector as the first and only R&D Center in Muğla.
arge.p2: In our R&D Center, we manage new product design, engineering analyses, prototyping, testing, validation, production method development, and intellectual property processes in a holistic approach with 30 full-time equivalent qualified R&D personnel working as researchers, technicians, and support staff.
arge.p3: We view nationalization and localization efforts for our country as a strategic responsibility; we develop solutions that reduce external dependency, are rapidly applicable, and directly respond to customer needs. In all our R&D processes from design to production, from analysis to field application, we adhere to the principles of safety, quality, compliance with international standards, and sustainability.
arge.p4: Projects developed at Polgün R&D Center add value to the sector in areas such as water savings, user safety, capacity increase, thematic experience, modular production, composite material technologies, and next-generation water slide geometries. Our innovative product projects such as Navatu, Savana, Monarch Butterfly, and Eclipse are among the important R&D outputs that represent Polgün's design, engineering, and production strength in the international market.
arge.p5: Our R&D activities are not limited to new product development alone. We also carry out continuous development work to improve the performance of existing products, improve production processes, reduce environmental impacts, increase material efficiency, and increase our competitive power in international markets. We strengthen our corporate knowledge base through academic collaborations, scientific publications, patent and design registration processes; and transform the outputs obtained into a sustainable innovation culture.
arge.misyon_desc: To bring unique solutions to the water entertainment industry by developing high-quality, safe, cost-effective, and innovative R&D projects; and to create pioneering products that represent our country in national and international markets. We aim to bring qualified knowledge, technology, and human resources to our sector by adhering to work schedules, engineering verifications, standards compliance, and sustainable production principles in our R&D processes.
arge.vizyon_desc: As Polgün Waterparks R&D Center, our vision is to be a leading and pioneering R&D center that shapes water entertainment technologies with its unique designs, innovative engineering solutions, strong production capability, and projects in compliance with international standards. We aim to become a brand recognized both nationally and internationally with projects we develop without compromising quality.
arge.navatu_desc: An innovative waterpark system that takes the natural wave experience to a new dimension.
arge.savana_sub: Themed Water Slide with Multiple Slide Paths
arge.savana_desc: An innovative R&D project that combines four different slide paths in a single structure.
arge.fikri_sinai_desc: Technological innovations and designs developed by Polgün R&D Center are protected by national and international registrations.
arge.brands_desc: Polgün's trademarks registered in Turkey and internationally are a symbol of our original identity and our reliability.

minister.title: We had the honor of hosting our Minister of Industry and Technology, Mr. Mehmet Fatih Kacır, at Polgün Waterparks
minister.desc:
We were proud to host at our factory the delegation accompanied by Governor of Muğla Mr. İdris Akbıyık, Muğla Members of Parliament Mr. Kadem Mete and Mr. Yakup Otgöz, District Governor of Menteşe Mr. Mehmet Eriş, AK Party Provincial Chairman Mr. Haluk Laçin, MHP Provincial Chairman Mr. Burak Demirel, and Mayor of Kavaklıdere Mr. Mehmet Demir. The delegation visited our production facility in Muğla and examined our R&D center.

As one of the global leaders in the industry, we take great pride in our commitment to innovation, quality, and excellence. Their visit once again demonstrated the importance of advanced production technologies and R&D in shaping the future. We sincerely thank them for their kind visit, interest, and support.

msku.title: Muğla Sıtkı Koçman University Visit
msku.desc: During the MSKÜ management's visit to Polgün, R&D, production, and design activities were examined on site. University-industry cooperation was strengthened.

history.title: Our History
history.desc: Over the years, we have grown by continuously developing our production power, engineering competence, and global project experience. Every step we have taken has become part of a stronger production infrastructure, innovative products, and the Polgün journey that today reaches more than 70 countries.
history.desc1: Polgün continues its infrastructure investments without interruption in order to meet growing capacity needs and advance its production capabilities; while creating new production areas for polyester, thermoplastic coating, and painting processes in its existing facilities in Muğla, it reinforces its operational power, growing on an international scale, by reaching a total production area of 120,000 m² with the new factory investment in Bursa.
history.desc2: To take its R&D and design competence even further, the application process for the Marmara Technopark office has been completed and the office became official with the signing of the contract. This step aims to strengthen university collaborations.
history.bold_summary: Today, Polgün strengthens its position in the international market with its manufacturing setup in Turkey and sales office in Spain.

milestones.2002: Polgün started its operations in Muğla-Menteşe.
milestones.2008: First international project delivery was accomplished.
milestones.2015: Production capacity was increased and new facilities were commissioned.
milestones.2021: Ministry-approved R&D Center status was obtained — Muğla's first and only R&D Center.
milestones.2025: A total of 120,000 m² production area was reached with the Bursa factory investment.
milestones.2026: University-industry cooperation was strengthened with the Marmara Technopark office.

pirate.name: Pirate Theme
pirate.desc: Designed as Polgün's signature theme and favored by many water parks, the Pirate Theme allows children to sail into open seas full of pirates and have fun in this imaginary world. Fully customizable in any size and desired color option, the Pirate Theme features giant parrots, an iconic shark, interactive water plays, palm trees, and a giant water bucket with a pirate head. When you see adults having as much fun as the little guests, choosing Polgün's Pirate Theme for your water park will be inevitable.

jungle.name: Jungle Theme
jungle.desc: Step into the wild with the Polgün Jungle Splash Tower, a themed water playground inspired by the beauty, energy, and mystery of tropical rainforests. Brought to life with forest characters that spark the imagination such as elephants, parrots, owls, squirrels, and giant trees, this theme creates an exciting environment where children can explore, play, and unleash their creativity. Nature-inspired details, interactive water features, and adventurous decorative elements turn the playground into a vivid jungle journey. Designed with earth tones, wood-look surfaces, and rich nature-themed graphics, the Jungle Splash Tower offers a unique visual identity for water parks, resorts, and family entertainment centers. With its fully customizable structure in terms of size, layout, color palette, and thematic details, it can be tailored to the concept and capacity needs of every project.

custom.name: Custom Theme
custom.desc: At Polgün, every project can be turned into a unique story. Our Custom Theme service combines creative design, conceptual development, and carefully selected color palettes to create water playgrounds that reflect the identity and vision of each venue. Supported by decades of industry experience, an in-house R&D team, and advanced CAD design capabilities, our designers develop original concepts tailored to the requirements of each project. From the initial idea to the final themed entertainment area, every detail is meticulously crafted to offer an engaging, visually stunning, and unforgettable experience for visitors. Whether inspired by nature, fantasy worlds, adventure, or starting from a completely original concept, Polgün produces fully personalized thematic solutions for water parks, resorts, hotels, and family entertainment centers.

underwater.name: Underwater Theme
underwater.desc: Oceans, seas, and the underwater world have always been a mysterious, exciting, and magical world for children. Designed with the Polgün Underwater Theme, drawing on the many species waiting to be discovered in the underwater world and colorful corals, this waterpark is a colorful environment that supports children's imagination, excites them, and lets them have fun. All the colors used in the waterpark are inspired by the living species and coral colors found in the underwater world.

candy.name: Candy Theme
candy.desc: Inspired by the world of sweets and candies, Candy Theme brings joy to waterparks with its vibrant colors and playful design. With a color palette that nurtures children's imagination and original animation products, Candy Theme gives your waterpark a distinctive identity. Bringing together pink, yellow, and pastel tones, this themed structure lets little guests enjoy moments they will never forget.

carnaval.name: Carnaval Theme
carnaval.desc: Bring the joyful spirit of the carnival to life with the Polgün Carnaval Splash Tower, a lively water playground designed to spark children's imagination and create unforgettable family moments. Inspired by the magical atmosphere of a festive fair, the Carnaval theme features colorful balloons, candy-like details, giant lollipops, and playful tent-style decorations that transform the play area into a dreamlike celebration. Interactive water features and vivid themed elements encourage children to explore, play, and enjoy an immersive water adventure. With its eye-catching visuals and cheerful character, the Carnaval Splash Tower becomes a captivating focal point for resorts, hotels, waterparks, and family entertainment centers. Fully customizable in size, layout, and color, it can be adapted to the unique concept and capacity needs of each project.

jurassic.name: Jurassic Theme
jurassic.desc: Bring the prehistoric world to life with the Polgün Jurassic Splash Tower, a themed water play area designed to spark curiosity, excitement, and a sense of adventure. Inspired by the fascinating age of dinosaurs, the Jurassic theme brings together impressive elements such as Apatosaurus figures, dinosaur eggs, wild plants, and cute baby T-Rex characters in an atmosphere reminiscent of the Mesozoic Era. These creative details create an engaging environment where children can enjoy lively water play while exploring a world inspired by prehistoric biodiversity. Combining adventurous visuals with interactive water features, the Jurassic Splash Tower becomes a captivating focal point for waterparks, resorts, and family entertainment centers. Fully customizable in size, layout, color palette, and thematic components, it can be adapted to the concept and capacity needs of every project.

galaxy.name: Galaxy Theme
galaxy.desc: Get ready for takeoff with the Polgün Galaxy Splash Tower, a themed water play area designed to take children on an exciting journey through the wonders of the universe. Inspired by the mystery of space, the Galaxy theme combines imagination-sparking elements such as rockets, planets, aliens, and cosmic-inspired animations with striking artistic details. Interactive water features and adventurous themed components encourage children to play, slide, and explore, while awakening their imagination and their curiosity about the unknown. With its dynamic concept and visually captivating space-inspired design, the Galaxy Splash Tower creates an unforgettable attraction for waterparks, resorts, and family entertainment centers. Fully customizable in size, layout, color palette, and thematic details, it can be adapted to the concept and capacity needs of every project.
